import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Arenas: the reference library abstraction (Part XIV)

Arenas of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, Part XIV (§76–§78), with §36, §46, §55,
§56, §58, §79, §86 and §88. An arena is a library abstraction (Part XIV): its entries live in a
library state separate from the kernel state `S₃` (§38, §46). `newArena` (O17) only registers an
entry; `issue` (O18) and `reset` (O19) are defined twice:

* as their contracts, clause by clause (§77, §78): `IssueC`, `ResetC`;
* as derived operations over the kernel steps (Part XIV): `issue` is its static checks, the
  availability `fail`, then `split` of `internal` on the region and `store` of the block into the
  destination (`IssueD`); `reset` is `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the whole storage,
  then `release`, then the explicit check of §78.3 (`ResetD`), which never rejects after an
  accepted `derive` on states satisfying I3 (`resetNoDeps_of_derive`).

On library-reachable states, `issue_as_kernel` and `reset_as_kernel` show that both definitions
have the same outcomes and the same arrival states, `reset_iff_derive_release` that `reset` is
accepted or rejected exactly when `derive` then `release` is (Q7), and `lReach_inv` that every
live entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (§55). Library reachability (`LReach`, `LReachNG`) uses the derived
operations, so its kernel states are kernel-reachable (`newArena_as_library`) and satisfy the
kernel invariant of §57 (`Access.reachable_kinv`).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Library state (§46) -/

/-- Arena entry (§46): administered storage, `internal` authority, available leaves and issued
regions with their block authorities. The sets of §46 are lists read by membership. -/
structure ArenaEntry where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Library state (§46, §38): the kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the arena registry. -/
structure LState where
  kern : S3
  arenas : List ArenaEntry

/-- Initial library state (§47): the initial kernel state and an empty arena registry. -/
def LState.init (statics : Statics) : LState := ⟨S3.init statics, []⟩

/-- Live arena (§46): `internal` is active. -/
def Live (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := s.Active E.internal

/-- Decidability of `Live` (§46). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (Live s E) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (s.Active _))

/-- Arena value (§46): the place holding `internal`. -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[E.internal]? with
  | some y => match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
no `writeShared` branch. -/
def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
available. -/
def Avail (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ E.available

/-- Decidability of `Avail` (§46). -/
instance (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail E region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-! ## `ArenaInv` (§55) -/

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55), required for live arenas. "Still-issued" is read as "with an active block
authority". The clause "anchor and ownership restrictions are respected" has no referent and is
not represented; "complying with exclusivity and validity rules" is left to the kernel
invariants (§57). -/
structure ArenaInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §55, item 1: `storage` designates an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable E.storage
  /-- §55, item 1: the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`. -/
  fpEq : ∀ l, l ∈ s.afp E.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` is active. -/
  active : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` has own mode `Modify` and is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  shape : OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §55, item 3: available leaves belong to the administered storage. -/
  availableIn : ∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 3: issued regions belong to the administered storage. -/
  issuedIn : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 4: two still-active issuances have disjoint regions. -/
  disjoint : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
    ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1
  /-- §55, item 4: no leaf of a still-issued region belongs to `available`. -/
  notAvailable : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available
  /-- §55, item 5: every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal`. -/
  derived : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2

/-- Decidability of `ArenaInv` (§55): the footprint equality is the two inclusions. -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ArenaInv s E) :=
  @decidable_of_iff (ArenaInv s E) ((s.Usable E.storage ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp E.internal, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage, l ∈ s.afp E.internal) ∧ s.Active E.internal ∧
    OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False) ∧
    ((∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage)) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
      ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2))
    ⟨fun ⟨⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, ⟨f, g⟩, h, i, j⟩ => ⟨a, fun l => ⟨b l, c l⟩, d, e, f, g, h, i, j⟩,
     fun h => ⟨⟨h.storageUsable, fun l => (h.fpEq l).1, fun l => (h.fpEq l).2, h.active,
      h.shape⟩, ⟨h.availableIn, h.issuedIn⟩, h.disjoint, h.notAvailable, h.derived⟩⟩
    (@instDecidableAnd _ _ inferInstance (@instDecidableAnd _ _ inferInstance inferInstance))

/-- Shape of the issued blocks (support for §55, item 5, from the `ok` effect of §77; not a clause
of `ArenaInv`): every issued block authority exists, has direct origin `internal`, a fresh identity
above it, its region as footprint and mode `Modify`. -/
def IssuedShape (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some E.internal ∧ E.internal < e.2 ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify

/-- The per-entry library invariant (§55): `ArenaInv` and the auxiliary `IssuedShape`. -/
def EntryInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := ArenaInv s E ∧ IssuedShape s E

/-- The library invariant (§55, §46): every registered `internal` exists, and every live entry
satisfies `EntryInv`. -/
def LInv (L : LState) : Prop :=
  ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, E.internal < L.kern.A.length ∧ (Live L.kern E → EntryInv L.kern E)

/-! ## A decision procedure for the kernel invariant on concrete states (§49–§54, §57)

| none => rw [hxa] at this; exact this.elim
    | some x => rw [hxa] at this; exact ⟨x, rfl, this⟩
  · have := h.noDangling j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    rw [hy] at this
    exact this ya q (List.mem_range.2 (footprint_lt hl)) hq l hl hly
  · have := h.rootHeldConv x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hz))
    rw [hz] at this
    have h' := this hzo l hl r (List.mem_range.2 hr.1) hr hlr
    cases hp : s.P[r]? with
    | none => rw [hp] at h'; exact h'.elim
    | some pr => rw [hp] at h'; exact ⟨pr, rfl, h'⟩

/-! ## O17 `newArena` (§76) and the guard of §56 -/

/-- All leaves of the place holding an authority are `Init` (§76.5); vacuous for a frame. -/
def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
  | .frame _ => True

/-- Decidability of `LeavesInit` (§76.5). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance

/-- The unified administration guard (§56, §76.4) as a contract predicate: `internal` is absent
from every registry of live administrations. A registry is given by the `internal` identities of
its live administrations; `regs` lists all relevant registries. -/
def Guard56 (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Prop := ∀ R ∈ regs, i ∉ R

/-- Decidability of `Guard56` (§56). -/
instance (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 regs i) := by
  unfold Guard56; infer_instance

/-- The arena registry as a registry of live administrations (§46, §56): the `internal`
identities of its live entries. -/
def liveInternals (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) : List Nat :=
  (arenas.filter fun E => decide (s.Active E.internal)).map (·.internal)

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` other than the guard (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5,
§76.6). §76.6 is read on the resulting state (v0.1 §76.6): its kernel component is `s`, since
`newArena` changes no kernel component (§76 `ok` effect, `newArena_kernel`), so `WF3`, `I1`,
`AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` are required of the whole kernel state `s`; the new entry is
the one `newArenaEff` registers, `available` holding the leaves of the storage and `issued`
empty, and it must satisfy `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
structure NewArenaBase (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable storage
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
  storageRight : HasRight s .modify storage
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt internal .modify
  /-- §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal
  /-- §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True
  /-- §76.6: `WF3` (§49) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  wf3 : WF3 s
  /-- §76.6: `I1` (§50) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  i1 : I1 s
  /-- §76.6: `AnchorOrder` (§44) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder s
  /-- §76.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld s
  /-- §76.6: the new entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
  arenaInv : ArenaInv s ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaBase` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaBase s storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True ∧
    WF3 s ∧ I1 s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
    ArenaInv s ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩⟩

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76): those of `NewArenaBase` and the guard of
§76.4 over the arena registry and the other registries `others` (§56). -/
structure NewArenaPre (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6 (read on the resulting state, v0.1 §76.6). -/
  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- §76.4, §56: no live administration of any relevant registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaPre` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena` as a relation (§76, §58): `ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of
live administrations consulted by the guard (§56). -/
def NewArenaStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)

/-! ## O18 `issue` (§77) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `issue(arena, region, destination)` (§77.1, §77.2). The static
restrictions of §77.3 are given no list by the text and are not represented. -/
structure IssueStatic (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §77.1: the entry is live; `internal` is active. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §77.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §77.2: `region` belongs to the administered storage. -/
  regionIn : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is a leaf. -/
  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` holds no active authority. -/
  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
  /-- §77.2: `destination` can legally receive the block value in mode `Modify`. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §77.2: local self-blocking prevention, `destination` is not in `region`. -/
  dstNotIn : dst ∉ region

/-- Decidability of `IssueStatic` (§77). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (IssueStatic s E region dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True) ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ dst ∉ region)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- §77.5: the effective mode of `internal` permits `Modify` on every leaf of the region. -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s E.internal l) .modify

/-- Decidability of `IssueRight` (§77.5). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s E region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Kernel part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect): a block authority of fresh identity
`|A|`, derived from `internal`, of mode `Modify`, on the region, held by `destination`, which
receives the corresponding anchor; only leaf `destination` becomes `Init`. -/
def issueKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩]
    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ [s.A.length] else s.D q
    I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l }

/-- Metadata part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect; §46): the leaves of the region leave
`available`; the issuance joins `issued` with its authority. -/
def issueMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : ArenaEntry :=
  { E with
    available := E.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
    issued := (region, s.A.length) :: E.issued }

/-- Checks of `issue` on the simulated resulting state (§77.3, §77.6). -/
structure IssueArrival (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §77.3: `AnchorOrder` for the new anchor of `destination`, in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
    ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst)
  /-- §77.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst)
  /-- §77.6, O8.5: `destination` remains under exercisable `Modify` in the resulting state. -/
  keepsDst : HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst

/-- Decidability of `IssueArrival` (§77). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (IssueArrival s E region dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
      ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst) ∧
    HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩

/-- Library state after an `ok` issue of entry `i` (§77, `ok` effect). -/
def issueL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : LState :=
  ⟨issueKEff L.kern E region dst, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩

/-- The contract of `issue` on entry `i` (§77, §58): `reject` when the entry is missing or a
static precondition fails; `fail`, the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable (§77.4);
`reject` when the effective right (§77.5) or a check on the resulting state (§77.3, §77.6)
fails; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive IssueC (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      ¬ Avail E region → IssueC i region dst L .fail
  | noRight {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → ¬ IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | noArrival {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → ¬ IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L (.ok (issueL L i E region dst))

/-- `issue` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §77): its static checks, then the availability
`fail` (§77.4), then `split` of `internal` on the region (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh
identity `|A|`, into the destination (O8); the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
inductive IssueD (k : K) (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      ¬ Avail E region → IssueD k i region dst L .fail
  | split {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern .reject →
      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | store {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      IssueStatic L.kern E region dst → Avail E region →
      SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩)

/-! ## O19 `reset` (§78) -/

/-- §78.3 (v0.1): no still-usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of
`internal` that covers a leaf of the administered storage. Dependencies of contained values are
covered since parts are places. -/
def ResetNoDeps (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, E.internal ∈ s.ancs x →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp x, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage

/-- Decidability of `ResetNoDeps` (§78.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetNoDeps s E) := by
  unfold ResetNoDeps; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `reset(arena)` (§78). "`internal` and the arena's other restrictions remain
valid" (§78.1) and "validity obligations of other nested arenas remain satisfied" (§78.3) name no
checkable condition beyond `ArenaInv` and are not represented. -/
structure ResetPre (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §78.1: the entry is live. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §78.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §78.2: no active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the storage. -/
  noCover : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §78.3: no usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of `internal`
  covering a leaf of the storage. -/
  noDeps : ResetNoDeps s E

/-- Decidability of `ResetPre` (§78). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetPre s E) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
      ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ ResetNoDeps s E)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- Kernel part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, Part XIV): the record of the `Modify`
derivation of `internal` over all the storage, already released; no leaf becomes `Init`. -/
def resetKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint s.P E.storage, .frame s.top, false⟩] }

/-- Metadata part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, §46): all leaves of the storage
become available; `issued` is cleared. -/
def resetMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : ArenaEntry :=
  { E with available := footprint s.P E.storage, issued := [] }

/-- Library state after an `ok` reset of entry `i` (§78). -/
def resetL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) : LState :=
  ⟨resetKEff L.kern E, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩

/-- The contract of `reset` on entry `i` (§78, §58): `ok` when the entry exists and the
preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
inductive ResetC (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetC i L .reject
  | reject {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ ResetPre L.kern E → ResetC i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ResetPre L.kern E →
      ResetC i L (.ok (resetL L i E))

/-- `reset` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §78): `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the
footprint of the storage (O1), `release` of the derived authority (O3), then the explicit contract
check of §78.3; the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
inductive ResetD (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetD i L .reject
  | derive {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern .reject →
      ResetD i L .reject
  | release {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → ResetD i L .reject
  | contract {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ¬ ResetNoDeps L.kern E → ResetD i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ResetNoDeps L.kern E →
      ResetD i L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩)

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/

namespace Examples

/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  show (if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then InitSt.init else .uninit) = .init ↔ _
  cases statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-! ## Reachable states (§57) -/

/-- `KInv` (§57) and the auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` (not clauses of §57) hold on every
state reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound` (§80), for well-formed statics
(`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
theorem reachable_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact init_kinv hst
  | step _ h ih =>
    exact ⟨kstep_preserves hdd ih.1 ih.2.2 h, kstep_preserves_kAux ih.1 ih.2.1 h,
      kstep_preserves_heldAnchored ih.1.1 ih.2.2 h⟩

/-- The main invariant of §57: on states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`
(§80), `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan` holds, for well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`,
§47). -/
theorem reachable_kinv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : KInv s :=
  (reachable_inv hdd hst h).1

/-- `I5` (§57) on reachable states: under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), every leaf
pinned statically (`K.Pinned`) or by an active obligation (§74) belongs to a usable place in every
reachable state. No hypothesis on `K.Pinned`: initially every static is usable (§47) and a leaf
lies in its own footprint (§40). -/
theorem reachable_i5 {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : I5 k s := by
  induction h with
  | init =>
    intro l hlt hleaf _
    exact ⟨l, init_usable hst (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) (by rwa [initP_len] at hlt),
      mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlt, hleaf, hlt, .inl rfl⟩⟩
  | step hr h ih => exact kstep_preserves_i5 (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 ih h

/-! ## Initialization history (§59) -/

/-- Operation `op` writes leaf `l` from state `s` (§59): `write3` or `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, `store` into `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a destination leaf
corresponding to a source leaf `Init` before the step. -/

  | .write _ ls => l ∈ ls

import Ern.MemoryModel.Machine
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Refinement of the access kernel into the elementary memory machine (spec v0.1, Part XVII)

Source: `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, §82 (items 1–8) with §10, §16, §17, §23.

* A layout of places in allocations and its interface `LayoutWF` (§82.1, §23).
* The representation relation `Repr` between a kernel state (`Access.S3`) and an admissible state
  of the memory machine (`Machine.State`, §9) (§82.1, §82.3, §82.4, §82.5).
* For every kernel operation O1–O16, the sequence of raw operations that realizes its `ok` step,
  proven to be a sequence of `ok` raw steps that keeps `Repr` (§82 preamble, §82.2, §82.4, §82.5).
* Safe reads and writes (§82.2), lifetimes (§82.5), deallocation contracts (§82.4), pinned
  addresses under pinning obligations (§82.6, §74, §75), exclusivity of bytes (§82.8), pointers
  written by `store` (§82.2, §82.3), every region included.
* A simulation of runs from the initial state with parameters fixed once per run, and concrete
  runs checked by evaluation. On reachable states (§57, `Access.reachable_kinv`) the per-step
  results hold without invariant hypotheses (`*_reachable`).

The sequential fragment only (§18, §29): no theorem here says anything about concurrency.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Allocations of the memory machine (§9) -/

/-- The allocation `i` of `s2` is registered and satisfies `p` (§9, §11 ¶2). -/
def AllocP (s2 : Machine.State) (i : Nat) (p : Machine.Alloc → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, s2.allocs i = some a ∧ p a

/-- The allocation `i` of `s2` is registered and live (§9 ¶1, §17 ¶3). -/
abbrev LiveAlloc (s2 : Machine.State) (i : Nat) : Prop := AllocP s2 i (·.live = true)

/-- Weakening of the property of a registered allocation (§9). -/
theorem AllocP.mono {s : Machine.State} {i : Nat} {p q : Machine.Alloc → Prop}
    (h : AllocP s i p) (hpq : ∀ a, p a → q a) : AllocP s i q :=
  let ⟨a, ha, hp⟩ := h; ⟨a, ha, hpq a hp⟩

/-- Two properties of one registered allocation (§9). -/
theorem AllocP.and {s : Machine.State} {i : Nat} {p q : Machine.Alloc → Prop}
    (hp : AllocP s i p) (hq : AllocP s i q) : AllocP s i fun a => p a ∧ q a := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h1⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨b, hb, h2⟩ := hq
  rw [ha] at hb; cases hb
  exact ⟨a, ha, h1, h2⟩

/-- A registered allocation is below the counter of a state with fresh identities (§9 ¶7). -/
theorem AllocP.lt {s : Machine.State} (hwf : Machine.WF s) {i : Nat} {p : Machine.Alloc → Prop}
    (h : AllocP s i p) : i < s.next :=
  Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hle => by obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := h; rw [hwf i hle] at ha; cases ha

/-- Base address of the allocation `i` of `s2`, `0` if unregistered (§9 ¶1, §12 ¶1). -/
def baseOf (s2 : Machine.State) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((s2.allocs i).map (·.base)).getD 0

/-- The base of a registered allocation (§9 ¶1). -/
theorem baseOf_of {s2 : Machine.State} {i : Nat} {a : Machine.Alloc} (h : s2.allocs i = some a) :
    baseOf s2 i = a.base := by
  simp [baseOf, h]

/-! ## Layout of places (§82.1, §23) -/

/-- Layout of places (§82.1): place `q` occupies the range `L q` of the elementary memory machine:
an allocation identity, an offset and a length (§11 ¶1). A parameter fixed for a run, defined on
every index, present or future. Only the allocation of a non-leaf place is read. -/
abbrev Layout := Nat → Machine.Place

/-- Layout interface in the states `s3`, `s2` (§82.1; §23 "a memory layout satisfying
`LayoutWF`"). The spec names `LayoutWF` without stating its clauses; the clauses below are the
guarantees §82.1 and §23 ask the layout to provide. No lower bound on lengths: a leaf may have
size zero (§71.1). -/
structure LayoutWF (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) : Prop where
  /-- §82.1 (parts): a structural part lies in the allocation of its parent. -/
  parts : ∀ q r, parentOf s3.P q = some r → (L q).alloc = (L r).alloc
  /-- §23, §82.1 (disjointness): two distinct leaves in one allocation have disjoint ranges. -/
  disjoint : ∀ l l', l < s3.P.length → l' < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l → isLeaf s3.P l' →
    l ≠ l' → (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc →
    Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len
  /-- §82.1, §15 ¶1: the range of a leaf lies within its allocation, which is registered. -/
  within : ∀ l, l < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l →
    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size

/-- Elements of a parent chain lie in the allocation of its start (§82.1 parts, §40). -/
theorem alloc_chainF {L : Layout} {P : List Place}
    (hp : ∀ q r, parentOf P q = some r → (L q).alloc = (L r).alloc) :
    ∀ k i r, r ∈ chainF (parentOf P) k i → (L i).alloc = (L r).alloc
  | 0, _, _, h => by simp [chainF] at h
  | k + 1, i, r, h => by
    simp only [chainF] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i o ho
      split at h
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
        · exact hp i _ ho
        · exact (hp i o ho).trans (alloc_chainF hp k o r h)
      · simp at h
    · simp at h

/-- A part lies in the allocation of every place it belongs to (§82.1 parts, §40). -/
theorem LayoutWF.alloc_part {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hl : LayoutWF L s3 s2)
    {l r : Nat} (h : partOf s3.P l r) : (L l).alloc = (L r).alloc := by
  rcases h.2 with rfl | h
  · rfl
  · exact alloc_chainF hl.parts l l r h

/-! ## Representation relation (§82.1, §82.3, §82.4, §82.5, §9) -/

/-- Representation relation between a kernel state `s3` and a state `s2` of the memory machine,
for the layout `L` and the deallocation tokens `rtok` recorded for the allocation of each root
place (`rtok r` for the root place `r`; §17 ¶4, §70.2):
- `adm`: `s2` is admissible (§9 ¶8: freshness, live disjointness, alignment);
- `layout`: the layout interface (§82.1, §23);
- `inj`: two distinct root places are in distinct allocations (§82.1: storage units and
  identities; §9 ¶5: subplaces are not new allocations, so parts share their root's);
- `tokens`: the allocation of a root place is registered and records the token `rtok r`
  (§82.4, §17 ¶4);
- `live`: the allocation of a usable root place is live (§82.5);
- `init`: the bytes of the range of an `Init` leaf are initialized (§82.3; `Uninit` and `Moved`
  impose nothing, §41).
It does not read the contract `K` (§48). -/
structure Repr (L : Layout) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) : Prop where
  /-- §9 ¶8: admissibility of the memory state. -/
  adm : Machine.Admissible s2
  /-- §82.1, §23: layout interface. -/
  layout : LayoutWF L s3 s2
  /-- §82.1, §9 ¶5: distinct root places, distinct allocations. -/
  inj : ∀ r r', RootPlace s3.P r → RootPlace s3.P r' → r ≠ r' → (L r).alloc ≠ (L r').alloc
  /-- §82.4, §17 ¶4: the allocation of a root place is registered with the token `rtok r`. -/
  tokens : ∀ r, RootPlace s3.P r → AllocP s2 (L r).alloc fun a => a.freeAuth = some (rtok r)
  /-- §82.5: the allocation of a usable root place is live. -/
  live : ∀ r, RootPlace s3.P r → s3.Usable r → LiveAlloc s2 (L r).alloc
  /-- §82.3: the range of an `Init` leaf is initialized. -/
  init : ∀ l, l < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l → s3.I l = .init →

exact reset_no_access_issued hE
    ((lReachNG_inv hdd hst hL.ng E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE)).2 hlive) hr hp

/-- §82.7 for translated library runs: the kernel steps of the derived operations are realized
by O1–O16 without reintroducing access after invalidation. The run is a labelled library run from
the initial library state; its memory state is reached from the initial memory state by the raw
operations of its kernel steps (the machine trace of the run is the trace of its kernel steps);
and after every legal `reset` in the run, no kernel step of the continuation uses an authority
derived from `internal` that covered a leaf of the administered storage, so no raw operation of
the continuation is an access through it.

The metadata (`available`, `issued`) is not realized: it is library state with no machine
realization in this model, so the "metadata" part of §82.7 is not covered. This is a reading,
recorded, not settled by the spec: §46 puts the entries in the library's abstract state, separate
from `S₃`, and §81 leaves the representation of library metadata to Spec 11; §36, §71.2 and §76.5
(with the last paragraph of §77) instead speak of metadata kept in storage (`SharedMutable`
storage updated by `writeShared`, provider metadata, the leaves of the arena value), which would
require raw writes realizing each metadata update. -/
theorem arena_realized {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
    ∃ t, LPath k (LState.init statics) t L ∧
      s2 = run (minit π statics) (ktrace π (ltrace t) (minit π statics)) ∧
      ∀ t₁ t₂ L₀ i E, t = t₁ ++ (.reset i, L₀) :: t₂ → L₀.arenas[i]? = some E →
        ∀ j, E.internal ∈ L₀.kern.ancs j →
          (∃ l ∈ L₀.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L₀.kern.P E.storage) →
          ∀ q ∈ ltrace t₂, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
  obtain ⟨t, hp, hs⟩ := h.trace
  refine ⟨t, hp, hs, ?_⟩
  rintro t₁ t₂ L₀ i E rfl hE j hj hc
  obtain ⟨L₁, hr, hp₂⟩ := LPath.split t₁ hp
  exact reset_no_access hE hr hp₂ hj hc

  | free => exact .free h
  | alloc => exact .alloc h
  | store => exact .store h

/-! ## Parameters of a run and realization of each step (§82, §20.3) -/

/-- Parameters of the refinement, fixed once for a run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the layout of the places
(§82.1), the deallocation token recorded for the allocation of each root place (§17 ¶4, §82.4),
the placement and geometry of new allocations (§9 ¶11, §82.4), the type of each leaf (§15, §16;
types belong to Spec 4), the encoding of references (§82.3; Spec 11), the initial representation
of the static leaves (§47, §10 ¶5). -/
structure Params (Ty : Type) where
  /-- §82.1: layout of the places. -/
  L : Layout
  /-- §17 ¶4, §82.4: token recorded for the allocation of each root place. -/
  rtok : Nat → Nat
  /-- §9 ¶11, §82.4: placement of new allocations. -/
  pl : Placement
  /-- §9 ¶1: geometry of the allocation of each root place. -/
  geom : Nat → Geom
  /-- §15, §16: type of each leaf. -/
  ty : Nat → Ty
  /-- §82.3: encoding of references. -/
  pe : PtrEnc
  /-- §47, §10 ¶5: initial representation of the static leaves. -/
  ival : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat

/-- Obligations of the parameters (§9 ¶11, §17.2): a valid placement, valid alignments, and each
recorded token compatible with itself (the automatic deallocation at `exitFrame` presents the
recorded token, §73, §82.5). -/
def ParamsOK {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (π : Params Ty) : Prop :=
  PlacementOK π.pl ∧ GeomOK π.geom ∧ ∀ r, C (π.rtok r) (π.rtok r)

/-- The raw operations realizing a kernel step from `s3`, the memory state being `s2` (§82
preamble; §82.2–§82.5): computed from the parameters and the two states, nothing chosen per
step. -/
def opsOf {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) : KOp → S3 → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | .transfer src dst, s3, s2 => transferOps π.L π.ty s2 s3 src dst
  | .enter _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .exit, s3, _ => exitOps π.L π.rtok s3
  | .read _ ls, _, s2 => readOps s2 π.L π.ty ls
  | .write _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
  | .writeShared _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
  | .free p auth, _, _ => freeOps π.L p auth
  | .alloc _ _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .store a p, s3, s2 => storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty s3 a p
  | _, _, _ => []

/-- Obligations of one step (§20.3, §82): the parametric obligations of its reads and writes
(§20.3, §15, §16); the layout of new places (`enterFrame`, `alloc`, §82.1, §23 `LayoutWF`); the
instantiation of `K.FreeCompat` on the deallocation compatibility of the machine (`free`, §80,
§70.2, §82.4). -/
def StepObl {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Params Ty) (op : KOp) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) :
    Prop :=
  OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2) ∧
    match op with
    | .enter _ ls => NewLayout π.L (enterP s3 ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom (rootIdx ls.toShape)
    | .alloc _ ow ls => NewLayout π.L (allocP s3 ow ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom
        (rootIdx ls.toShape)
    | .free p auth => k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C π.rtok p auth
    | _ => True

/-- Realization of every kernel step (§82 preamble, R6): under the obligations of the parameters,
`Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling` (parts of the kernel invariant `KInv`, §57) and the obligations of
the step, the raw operations of the step form an execution of `ok` raw steps, and `Repr` holds

1450:     {E : ArenaEntry} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')) :

1452:     L'.arenas[i]? = some (issueMeta L.kern E region) ∧
1453:     (∀ e ∈ E.issued, e ∈ (issueMeta L.kern E region).issued) ∧
1454:     (∀ x < L.kern.A.length, L'.kern.A[x]? = L.kern.A[x]?) ∧
1455:     (∀ l, l ≠ dst → L'.kern.I l = L.kern.I l) ∧ L'.kern.I dst = .init ∧
1456:     ∀ q, q ≠ dst → L'.kern.D q = L.kern.D q := by
1457:   cases hs with
1458:   | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' _ _ hsp hsto =>
1459:   rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
1460:   obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp

1476:   cases hs with
1477:   | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hst _ hsp hsto =>
1478:     intro l hl
1479:     obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
1480:     obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto
1481:     rw [← issueKEff_eq]
1482:     have hne : l ≠ dst := fun h => hst.dstNotIn (h ▸ hl)
1483:     simp [issueKEff, hne]
1484: 
----
1485: /-- v0.1 §86 (initialization state) for the contract of `issue` (§77): an `ok` leaves the
1486: initialization state of every leaf of the issued region unchanged. -/
1487: theorem issueC_keeps_init {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
1488:     (hs : IssueC i region dst L (.ok L')) : ∀ l ∈ region, L'.kern.I l = L.kern.I l := by
1489:   cases hs with
1490:   | ok _ hst _ _ _ =>
1491:     intro l hl
1492:     have hne : l ≠ dst := fun h => hst.dstNotIn (h ▸ hl)
1493:     simp [issueL, issueKEff, hne]
1494: 
----
1516: /-- §88, §77.2: `issue` into a leaf of the issued region is rejected, by a static check, even
1517: when the region is unavailable (no `fail`). -/
1518: theorem issue_into_region_rejected {L : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
1519:     {o : Outcome3 LState} (hd : dst ∈ region) (h : IssueC i region dst L o) : o = .reject := by
1520:   cases h with
1521:   | noEntry => rfl
1522:   | static => rfl
1523:   | fail _ hs => exact absurd hd hs.dstNotIn
1524:   | noRight => rfl
1525:   | noArrival => rfl
1526:   | ok _ hs => exact absurd hd hs.dstNotIn
1527: 
----
1528: /-- §88, §77.6 (O8.5): `issue` into a destination that would no longer be under exercisable
1529: `Modify` in the resulting state is not `ok`. -/
1530: theorem issue_keeps_dst {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
1531:     (h : IssueC i region dst L (.ok L')) :
1532:     ∃ E, L.arenas[i]? = some E ∧ HasRight (issueKEff L.kern E region dst) .modify dst := by
1533:   cases h with
1534:   | ok hE _ _ _ ha => exact ⟨_, hE, ha.keepsDst⟩
1535: 
----
2250: /-- `reset` ends every authority derived from `internal` covering a recycled leaf (§78.2, §78
2251: `ok` effect). -/
2252: theorem reset_ends_covering {L L₁ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
2253:     (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁)) {j : Nat}
2254:     (hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs j) (hc : ∃ l ∈ L.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P E.storage) :
2255:     ¬ L₁.kern.Active j := by
2256:   cases hr with
2257:   | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' hd hrl _ =>
2258:   rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
2259:   obtain ⟨hdp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
2260:   obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
2261:   rw [← resetKEff_eq]
2262:   intro ha
2263:   obtain ⟨l, hl, hls⟩ := hc
2264:   obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := ha
2265:   have hA : (resetKEff L.kern E).A = L.kern.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal,
2266:       footprint L.kern.P E.storage, .frame L.kern.top, false⟩] := rfl
----
2277: /-- `arena_reuse_safe` (§78, §86): after a legal `reset`, along every continuation of the library
2278: run, no authority that was derived from `internal` and covered a recycled leaf, previously issued
2279: blocks included, is active again, so none is exercisable: no access to it is possible. -/
2280: theorem arena_reuse_safe {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
2281:     (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁)) (hrun : LRun k L₁ L₂) {j : Nat}
2282:     (hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs j) (hc : ∃ l ∈ L.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P E.storage) :
2283:     ¬ L₂.kern.Active j ∧ ∀ m, ¬ L₂.kern.ExercisableAt j m := by
2284:   have h1 := reset_ends_covering hE hr hj hc
2285:   have hnot : ¬ L₂.kern.Active j := fun ha => by
2286:     by_cases hjl : j < L₁.kern.A.length
2287:     · exact h1 (hrun.akeep.active_back ha hjl)
2288:     · obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := ha
2289:       obtain ⟨l, hl, -⟩ := hc
2290:       have hjL : j < L.kern.A.length := by
2291:         cases hlj : L.kern.A[j]? with
2292:         | none => simp [S3.afp, hlj] at hl
2293:         | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hlj
2294:       exact hjl ((lstep_akeep (k := k) (.reset hr)).lt hjL)
----
2300: /-- `arena_reuse_safe` for the issued blocks, per step (§78, §86): after a legal `reset` of a live
2301: entry satisfying `EntryInv`, no block issued before it on a nonempty region is active or
2302: exercisable in any continuation of the library run. On library-reachable states the hypothesis
2303: holds (`arena_reuse_safe_issued`). -/
2304: theorem arena_reuse_safe_issued_of_inv {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
2305:     (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hinv : EntryInv L.kern E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁))
2306:     (hrun : LRun k L₁ L₂) :
2307:     ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.1 ≠ [] → ¬ L₂.kern.Active e.2 ∧ ∀ m, ¬ L₂.kern.ExercisableAt e.2 m := by
2308:   intro e he hne
2309:   obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hlt, hf, -⟩ := hinv.2 e he
2310:   have hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs e.2 := by
2311:     unfold S3.ancs; rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]) hlt]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
2312:   obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hne
2313:   exact arena_reuse_safe hE hr hrun hj
2314:     ⟨l, by simp [S3.afp, hy, hf, hl], hinv.1.issuedIn e he l hl⟩
2315: 
----
2316: /-- `arena_reuse_safe` for the issued blocks (§78, §86): after a legal `reset` of an entry of a
2317: library-reachable state, under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), no block issued before it
2318: on a nonempty region is active or exercisable in any continuation of the library run. The entry is
2319: live (§78.1, through §60.1) and satisfies `EntryInv` there (`lReachNG_inv`). -/
2320: theorem arena_reuse_safe_issued {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k)
2321:     (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L L₁ L₂ : LState} (hL : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat}
2322:     {E : ArenaEntry} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁))
2323:     (hrun : LRun k L₁ L₂) :
2324:     ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.1 ≠ [] → ¬ L₂.kern.Active e.2 ∧ ∀ m, ¬ L₂.kern.ExercisableAt e.2 m := by
2325:   have hlive : Live L.kern E := by
2326:     cases hr with
2327:     | @ok E' _ _ hE' hd _ _ =>
2328:       rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
2329:       exact (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).1.active
2330:   exact arena_reuse_safe_issued_of_inv hE
2331:     ((lReachNG_inv hdd hst hL.ng E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE)).2 hlive) hr hrun
2332:

1:/-- The guard of §56 keeps `internal` identities of live arenas unique along every guarded
2:library step; the kernel never reactivates an authority, and `issue` and `reset` keep the
3:`internal` of the entry (§56, Part XIV). -/
4:theorem unique56_step {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') (hr : RegOK L)
5:    (hu : Unique56 L) : RegOK L' ∧ Unique56 L' := by
6:  have hA := lstep_akeep h
7:  have back : ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, Live L'.kern E → Live L.kern E :=
8:    fun E hE hl => hA.active_back hl (hr E hE)
9:  cases h with
10:  | kernel hk =>
11:    refine ⟨fun E hE => hA.lt (hr E hE), fun i j E F hE hF hij hlE hlF => ?_⟩
12:    exact hu i j E F hE hF hij (back E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hlE)
13:      (back F (List.mem_of_getElem? hF) hlF)
14:  | newArena hs =>
15:    rename_i others st n
16:    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
17:    have hia := hp.base.internalAuth
18:    have hn : n < L.kern.A.length := by
19:      cases hy : L.kern.A[n]? with
20:      | none => rw [hy] at hia; exact hia.elim
21:      | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hy
22:    have hg : ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, Live L.kern E → E.internal ≠ n := by
23:      intro E hE hl he
24:      refine hp.guard _ (List.mem_cons_self ..) ?_
25:      rw [← he]
26:      exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨E, List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hE, by simpa [Live] using hl⟩, rfl⟩
27:    have hget : ∀ (j : Nat) (F : ArenaEntry), (newArenaEff L st n).arenas[j]? = some F →
28:        (j < L.arenas.length ∧ L.arenas[j]? = some F) ∨
29:          (j = L.arenas.length ∧ F = ⟨st, n, footprint L.kern.P st, []⟩) := by
30:      intro j F hF
31:      simp only [newArenaEff] at hF
32:      by_cases hj : j < L.arenas.length
33:      · exact .inl ⟨hj, by rwa [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at hF⟩
34:      · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hF
35:        cases h0 : j - L.arenas.length with
36:        | zero => rw [h0] at hF; simp at hF; exact .inr ⟨by omega, hF.symm⟩
37:        | succ m => rw [h0] at hF; simp at hF
38:    refine ⟨fun E hE => ?_, fun i j E F hE hF hij hlE hlF => ?_⟩
39:    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hE with hE | hE
40:      · exact hr E hE
41:      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hE]; exact hn
42:    · rcases hget i E hE with ⟨-, hE'⟩ | ⟨hi, rfl⟩ <;> rcases hget j F hF with ⟨-, hF'⟩ | ⟨hj, rfl⟩
43:      · exact hu i j E F hE' hF' hij hlE hlF
44:      · exact hg E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE') hlE
45:      · exact fun he => hg F (List.mem_of_getElem? hF') hlF he.symm
46:      · exact absurd (hi.trans hj.symm) hij
47:  | issue hs =>
48:    rename_i i₀ region dst
49:    cases hs with
50:    | @ok E₀ s₁ s₂ hE₀ _ _ hsp hsto =>
51:    have keep : ∀ (j : Nat) (F : ArenaEntry),
52:        (L.arenas.set i₀ (issueMeta L.kern E₀ region))[j]? = some F →
53:        ∃ G : ArenaEntry, L.arenas[j]? = some G ∧ G.internal = F.internal := by
54:      intro j F hF
55:      rcases get_set_internal hF with ⟨rfl, G, hG, rfl⟩ | hF
56:      · rw [hE₀] at hG; cases hG; exact ⟨E₀, hE₀, rfl⟩
57:      · exact ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩
58:    refine ⟨fun F hF => ?_, fun i j E F hE hF hij hlE hlF => ?_⟩
59:    · rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set hF with hF | rfl
60:      · exact hA.lt (hr F hF)
61:      · exact hA.lt (hr E₀ (List.mem_of_getElem? hE₀))
62:    · obtain ⟨G, hG, hGi⟩ := keep i E hE
63:      obtain ⟨H, hH, hHi⟩ := keep j F hF
64:      have hlG : Live L.kern G := back G (List.mem_of_getElem? hG) (by simpa [Live, hGi] using hlE)
65:      have hlH : Live L.kern H := back H (List.mem_of_getElem? hH) (by simpa [Live, hHi] using hlF)
66:      rw [← hGi, ← hHi]; exact hu i j G H hG hH hij hlG hlH
67:  | reset hs =>
68:    rename_i i₀
69:    cases hs with
70:    | @ok E₀ s₁ s₂ hE₀ _ _ _ =>
71:    have keep : ∀ (j : Nat) (F : ArenaEntry), (L.arenas.set i₀ (resetMeta L.kern E₀))[j]? = some F →
72:        ∃ G : ArenaEntry, L.arenas[j]? = some G ∧ G.internal = F.internal := by
73:      intro j F hF
74:      rcases get_set_internal hF with ⟨rfl, G, hG, rfl⟩ | hF
75:      · rw [hE₀] at hG; cases hG; exact ⟨E₀, hE₀, rfl⟩
76:      · exact ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩
77:    refine ⟨fun F hF => ?_, fun i j E F hE hF hij hlE hlF => ?_⟩
78:    · rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set hF with hF | rfl
79:      · exact hA.lt (hr F hF)
80:      · exact hA.lt (hr E₀ (List.mem_of_getElem? hE₀))
81:    · obtain ⟨G, hG, hGi⟩ := keep i E hE
82:      obtain ⟨H, hH, hHi⟩ := keep j F hF
83:      have hlG : Live L.kern G := back G (List.mem_of_getElem? hG) (by simpa [Live, hGi] using hlE)
84:      have hlH : Live L.kern H := back H (List.mem_of_getElem? hH) (by simpa [Live, hHi] using hlF)
85:      rw [← hGi, ← hHi]; exact hu i j G H hG hH hij hlG hlH
86:/-- §56 for the arena registry: in every library-reachable state, an authority identity serves as
87:`internal` for at most one live entry. The other registries are library parameters (`others`),
88:whose own uniqueness belongs to their contracts. -/
89:theorem live_internal_unique {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : LState}
90:    (h : LReach k statics L) : Unique56 L := by
91:  have : RegOK L ∧ Unique56 L := by
92:    induction h with
93:    | init => exact ⟨fun E hE => (by cases hE), fun i _ E _ hE => (by simp [LState.init] at hE)⟩
94:    | step _ hs ih => exact unique56_step hs ih.1 ih.2
95:  exact this.2
96:/-! ## Witness on a library-reachable state (§86)
97:A run from `LState.init Examples.st` (§47: static leaves 0 `Init`, 1 and 2 `Uninit`, with root
98:authorities 0, 1 and 2 held by frame 0) under the test contract `Examples.K0`: leaf 0 is the arena
99:value, leaf 1 the storage, leaf 2 the destination. Every precondition is decided by `decide`;
100:`KInv ∧ KAux` of the final state is decided through `KInvB`. -/
101:namespace Witness
102:open Examples
103:/-- Initial library state (§47). -/
104:def w0 : LState := LState.init st
105:/-- `derive(1, [1], Modify)`: authority 3 on the storage leaf, held by frame 0 (§60). -/
106:def w1 : LState := ⟨deriveEff w0.kern 1 [1] .modify, w0.arenas⟩
107:/-- `store(3, 0)`: authority 3 becomes `internal`, held by the arena value 0 (§65). -/
108:def w2 : LState := ⟨storeEff w1.kern 3 0, w1.arenas⟩
109:/-- `newArena(1, 3)` (§76). -/
110:def w3 : LState := newArenaEff w2 1 3
111:/-- The entry registered by `newArena(1, 3)` (§46, §76). -/
112:def wE : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [1], []⟩
113:/-- The common prefix is library-reachable (Part XIV, §76). -/
114:theorem w3_reach : LReach K0 st w3 := by
115:  have r1 : LReach K0 st w1 := .step .init (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
116:  have r2 : LReach K0 st w2 := .step r1 (.kernel (.store (.ok (by decide))))
117:  exact .step r2 (.newArena (others := []) (.ok (by decide)))
118:/-- `issue(0, [1], 2)`: `split(3, [[1]])` then `store(4, 2)` (§77). -/
119:def r4 : LState :=
120:  ⟨storeEff (splitEff w3.kern 3 [[1]]) w3.kern.A.length 2,
121:    w3.arenas.set 0 (issueMeta w3.kern wE [1])⟩
122:/-- `write(4, [1])`: the storage leaf 1 is written through block 4 (§67). -/
123:def r5 : LState := ⟨write3Eff r4.kern [1], r4.arenas⟩
124:/-- `endUse(2)`: the destination ends; block 4, held by it, is released (§69). -/
125:def r6 : LState := ⟨endUseEff r5.kern 2, r5.arenas⟩
126:/-- The entry after the first issue (§77 `ok` effect). -/
127:def rE : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [], [([1], 4)]⟩
128:/-- `reset(0)`: `derive(3, [1], Modify)`, `release(5)`, metadata restored (§78). -/
129:def r7 : LState :=
130:  ⟨releaseEff (deriveEff r6.kern 3 (footprint r6.kern.P 1) .modify) r6.kern.A.length,
131:    r6.arenas.set 0 (resetMeta r6.kern rE)⟩
132:/-- The entry after the reset (§78 `ok` effect). -/
133:def rE' : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [1], []⟩
134:/-- `issue(0, [1], 2)` again: `split(3, [[1]])` then `store(6, 2)` (§77). -/
135:def r8 : LState :=
136:  ⟨storeEff (splitEff r7.kern 3 [[1]]) r7.kern.A.length 2,
137:    r7.arenas.set 0 (issueMeta r7.kern rE' [1])⟩
138:/-- v0.1 §86, example: a reissued leaf keeps its initialization state and a read of it remains
139:subject to the ordinary conditions of the memory model. Leaf 1 is `Uninit` when it is first issued,
140:is written through block 4, keeps `Init` across `endUse` of the destination, the legal `reset`
141:(§78: "No leaf is made `Init` by `reset`") and the reissue, which modifies the initialization state
142:of no leaf of the region (§86, `issue_keeps_init`) and initializes only the destination 2 (§77).
143:In the final library-reachable state, `read` of leaf 1 through the new block 6 is `ok`: the leaf
144:is `Init` and block 6 is exercisable (§66). -/
145:theorem reissue_reads_former_value :
146:    LReach K0 st r8 ∧ KInv r8.kern ∧ KAux r8.kern ∧
147:    r4.kern.I 1 = .uninit ∧ r5.kern.I 1 = .init ∧ r7.kern.I 1 = .init ∧ r8.kern.I 1 = .init ∧
148:    ¬ r8.kern.Active 4 ∧
149:    (r8.kern.A[6]?).map (fun y => (y.origin, y.footprint, y.holder, y.active)) =
150:      some (some 3, [1], .place 2, true) ∧
151:    r8.arenas = [⟨1, 3, [], [([1], 6)]⟩] ∧
152:    Read3Step 6 [1] r8.kern (.ok r8.kern) := by
153:  have h4 : LReach K0 st r4 := .step w3_reach
154:    (.issue (i := 0) (region := [1]) (dst := 2)
155:      (.ok (E := wE) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))
156:  have h5 : LReach K0 st r5 := .step h4 (.kernel (.write (a := 4) (.ok (by decide))))
157:  have h6 : LReach K0 st r6 := .step h5 (.kernel (.endUse (.ok (by decide))))
158:  have h7 : LReach K0 st r7 := .step h6
159:    (.reset (i := 0) (.ok (E := rE) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide)))
160:  have h8 : LReach K0 st r8 := .step h7
161:    (.issue (i := 0) (region := [1]) (dst := 2)
162:      (.ok (E := rE') (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))
163:  have hk := KInvB.sound (s := r8.kern) (by decide)
164:  exact ⟨h8, hk.1, hk.2, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
165:    by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩
166:end Witness
167:end Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

mode : Mode

deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Dynamic pinning obligation (§74, §75): the place `pin` was applied to, the leaves it pins, and
whether it is still active. Its identity is its index in `S3.pins`. -/
structure PinOb where
  place : Nat
  leaves : List Nat
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State `S3` (§38). `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` are the components of §38. `nF` (next fresh frame
identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pins` (dynamic pinning obligations,
§74, §75) are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l

/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
receiving the shape. -/
abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
  Pinned : Nat → Prop
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop

/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)

/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i

/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x

/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true

/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
  match h : s.A[x]? with
  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'

/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

1886: /-- The raw operations realizing the initial state (§47, §10 ¶5, §82.6): one allocation per root
1887: static, then one write of the declared initial representation `ival l` into each static leaf
1888: declared `Init` (initializing static values is an additional operation, §10 ¶5). -/
1909: /-- Realization of the initial state (§82 preamble, §47, §82.6, §10 ¶5): under the acyclic
1910: ownership of statics that §47 requires (`StaticsOK`, §47), a valid placement and geometries, the
1911: layout obligations of the statics and the parametric obligations of the initializing writes, the
1912: creations of the static allocations followed by the writes of the static leaves declared `Init`
1913: form an execution of `ok` raw steps from the empty state (§9 ¶9), and `Repr` holds between
1914: `S3.init statics` and the reached state. -/
2299: /-- `pinned_address_stable` (§82.6, §74, §75; §63.5, §69.4, §70.4, §73.3): for every realized
2300: kernel step (`r6`), a leaf covered by an active dynamic pinning obligation (§74: a leaf is pinned
2301: while an active obligation covers it) or pinned by `K.Pinned`, whose allocation is live before the
2302: step, keeps a live allocation and the same address after the raw operations of the step. The
2303: memory machine never moves an allocation (§13); the content is that no deallocation of the step
2304: touches a pinned leaf. -/
2305: theorem pinned_address_stable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {op : KOp}
2306:     {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3)
2307:     (hnd : NoDangling s3) (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') {l : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length)
2308:     (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l)
2309:     (hpin : (∃ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧
2310:       l ∈ ob.leaves) ∨ k.Pinned l)
2311:     (hlive : LiveAlloc s2 (π.L l).alloc) :
2312:     LiveAlloc (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) (π.L l).alloc ∧
2313:       leafAddr (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) π.L l = leafAddr s2 π.L l := by
2314:   have hwf := hR.adm.wf
2315:   have haddr : leafAddr (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) π.L l = leafAddr s2 π.L l := by
2316:     simp only [leafAddr]; rw [baseOf_run hwf _ (hlive.mono fun _ _ => trivial)]
2317:   refine ⟨?_, haddr⟩
2318:   have hnod : (∀ o ∈ opsOf π op s3 s2, NoDealloc o) →
2319:       LiveAlloc (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) (π.L l).alloc :=
2320:     fun hn => live_run _ _ hwf hn hlive
2321:   have hpinned : ¬ (s3.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) := fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => by
2322:     rcases hpin with h | h
2323:     · rw [S3.pin_iff.2 h] at h1; cases h1
2324:     · exact h2 h
2325:   cases op with
2326:   | transfer => exact hnod (copyOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _)
2327:   | enter => exact hnod (allocOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _ _)
2393: /-- The move half of §82.6 on the kernel step (§63.5, §74, §87, §35 ¶2): an `ok` `transfer` moves
2394: no pinned in-place leaf. A leaf covered before the step by an active dynamic pinning obligation
2395: (§74) or pinned by `K.Pinned` is not an in-place leaf of the source (the leaves that the step
2396: moves), and its initialization state does not become `Moved`. -/
2397: theorem transfer_pinned_not_moved {k : K} {s3 s3' : S3} {src dst l : Nat}
2398:     (h : TransferStep k src dst s3 (.ok s3'))
2399:     (hpin : (∃ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧
2400:       l ∈ ob.leaves) ∨ k.Pinned l) :
2401:     l ∉ footprint s3.P src ∧ (s3'.I l = .moved → s3.I l = .moved) := by
2402:   obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
2403:   have hns : l ∉ footprint s3.P src := fun hl => by
2404:     obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpre.notPinned l hl
2405:     rcases hpin with hp | hp
2406:     · rw [S3.pin_iff.2 hp] at h2; cases h2
2407:     · exact h1 hp
2408:   refine ⟨hns, fun hm => ?_⟩
2409:   simp only [transferEff] at hm
2414: /-- The move half of §82.6 on the realization (§63.5, §74, §87, §82.3): every read among the raw
2415: operations realizing an `ok` `transfer`, by which a value is copied into the destination, is the
2416: access to the range of an in-place leaf of the source that no active dynamic pinning obligation
2417: covers (§74) and that `K.Pinned` does not pin. -/
2418: theorem transfer_reads_unpinned {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {s3 s3' : S3}
2419:     {s2 : Machine.State} {src dst : Nat} (h : TransferStep k src dst s3 (.ok s3'))
2420:     {ac : Machine.Access} {t : Ty}

/-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-3 (mandatory proof (2) of arbitration Q3): the metadata update of
`freeSlot` (free state, generation) is realizable by an authorized write under the administration
right. On every library-reachable state, under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), for every
pool with `AdminRight` (§36), the pool value `v` (the place holding `internal`) exists and the
kernel `write` (§67) of the leaves of `v` through the authority grounding `MetaRight` is accepted;
when the leaves of `v` are `Init`, its effect is the identity on the kernel state. §76.5 requires
`Init` leaves only when the pool is created: on a library-reachable state with `AdminRight`, a leaf
of `v` can be `Moved` (`Witness.meta_write_not_identity`), and the write then changes the kernel
state, while `freeSlot` leaves it unchanged (`freeSlot_effect`). -/
theorem freeSlot_meta_write {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L : PState} (hr : PReach k statics L) {pl : Pool}
    (hR : AdminRight L.kern pl) :
    ∃ v a, Arena.arenaValue L.kern pl.entry = some v ∧
      Write3Step a (footprint L.kern.P v) L.kern (.ok (write3Eff L.kern (footprint L.kern.P v))) ∧
      ((∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P v, L.kern.I l = .init) →
        write3Eff L.kern (footprint L.kern.P v) = L.kern) := by
  have hk := kernel_guarantee hdd hst L hr
  obtain ⟨⟨y, hy, ya⟩, hm⟩ := hR
  unfold Arena.MetaRight at hm
  cases hv : Arena.arenaValue L.kern pl.entry with
  | none => rw [hv] at hm; exact (hm : False).elim
  | some v =>
    rw [hv] at hm
    obtain ⟨a, -, hex, hall⟩ : HasRight L.kern .modify v := hm
    have hhold : y.holder = .place v := by
      simp only [Arena.arenaValue, Pool.entry, hy] at hv
      revert hv; cases y.holder <;> simp
    have hu : L.kern.Usable v := by
      have := hk.1.holders _ y hy ya; rw [hhold] at this; exact this
    exact ⟨v, a, rfl, Guarded.ok (write_of_right hk hu hex hall fun _ h => h), write3Eff_of_init⟩
